summary: Turn 26, in the run's final minutes. The previous feedback was accepted and pending_work remains empty, so I closed the last gap around the durability path that carries the run's only confirmed violation. New source S-DURABLE-LOG covers recordCommands (epaxos/epaxos.go:217-227): it writes each command back to back with no count and no instance header, and returns early for a nil slice. Read together with the already-recorded recordInstanceMetadata (epaxos/epaxos.go:199-215), which writes a fixed 9+r.N*4 byte record carrying the bal slot, vbal, status, seq and deps but no replica or instance identifier, the stable store is a stream of unaddressed metadata records interleaved with unlabelled command payloads, and callers invoke the two independently from startPhase1, handlePreAccept, handleAccept and handleCommit. So a restart reader would face three gaps before it could rebuild authority: the ballot is missing from its slot (the confirmed CLM-DURABLE-BAL violation), the metadata cannot be attributed to an instance, and command payloads are not delimited per instance. Submitted action=research with feedback referencing B-DURABLE-META, F-DURABLE-META, B-PROPOSE and S-DURABLE-META. It is recorded as a sourced unknown rather than a new candidate or obligation, because no reader exists in the captured files, so there is no observable endpoint to check and inventing a requirement for a format nobody reads would not be grounded; the remaining list also flags the attribution question (whether to report this format gap together with the confirmed violation or separately) and the still-unexercised A1 fast path, A2 authority transitions and A4 membership. Run state unchanged: one confirmed violation (CLM-DURABLE-BAL), four explained candidates, two paused candidates, no pending units, map at audit_spec_version 6. Preflight validation returns valid=true.
